mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC falls below 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to produce a statistically significant negative alpha at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% combined with a concurrent decline in retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 2% signals a broad-based contraction in economic output and demand, which depresses equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to produce a negative average 20-day return in at least 70% of triggered months, or the Sharpe ratio of triggered portfolios is not significantly different from zero.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% during a period of negative core CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%) signals an aggressive policy easing in response to deflation risk, which boosts risk appetite and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the positive rank IC is below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM > 0.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) of more than 0.8% month-over-month indicates strengthening aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 70% of triggered months, or the mechanism fails to outperform a flat benchmark.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annual core CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY) above 4.0% for six consecutive months, coupled with a federal funds rate below the lower bound implied by the Taylor rule (FEDFUNDS < 2.0% when inflation gap > 2%), signals policy lag and insufficient tightening, which erodes real equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0% for six months AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0%
regime_hint: sticky high inflation with accommodative policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.10.
